text: So I asked an AI assistant ten questions a developer would ask about hosted Postgres, one per call, with web search off.
Example Cloud was named in seven of the ten answers and first in four.
In the three answers that named it second, the product ahead was picked on pricing, which is where I would look first.
On Example Portal I built a knowledge graph on PostgreSQL and pgvector, and its pages have drawn 12,345 Google Search clicks.
I designed the Go services behind it, from the HTTP API down to the database schema
I also exposed our engines to AI agents through an MCP server and an OpenAI-compatible API that runs on the user's own laptop.
I design the architecture and direct AI coding agents, reviewing every change
A PostgreSQL graph backend I contributed was merged upstream
I would start with the three pricing questions, then repeat the test on assistants that search the web live.
The table with all ten answers is ready to send.
